repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · L1 · head `178bfae911b2dea7e9c98523b4fb4d900684b467` · 2026-11-26T01:01Z

PR #37362 (`Fixes #37139`, rider `Fixes #37349`), dev report 7177958131, head finalized by the zone at 2026-11-26T00:42Z. Read against GitHub and a throwaway worktree at head, not against the report.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

- **Landing:** the zone lands it. It is Tier S: not governed (`l1-face`: no governed path) and 1,632 changed lines, under 3,000. K = 8, below 15, so it does not merge main first. Flip it to ready and queue it. The merge closes both cards; drop `pm:dispatched` from #37139 and #37349 in the same stroke. Carry Q2 and Q3 to seat 4 (N7), with N2's veto-window note beside them.

### Checklist

- **Shape (`l1-face.mjs --pr 37362`).** Open, draft, base `main`. First line `Fixes #37139`. One changeset covers the published package touched, `@object-ui/i18n`; `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`. No release-notes path, no `+0/-0` file, dogfood not owed. The one flag is `keywords-other-cards` on `Fixes #37349`, which is the intended rider (N1). Read by eye, the body has no other closing keyword next to a card number.
- **Card table, item by item.** Read in `StudioPackageMenu.tsx` and checked against `PackageDetailSheet`'s gates at head.

  | Table item | At head | Greyed when (at head) | Table says |
  |:--|:--|:--|:--|
  | 编辑软件包信息 | `EditPackageDialog` (moved, same `PackageFormDialog` edit mode) on the `/api/v1/packages` listed manifest | `writable === false` | read-only package ✓ |
  | 导出 | `exportPackageFile` (the moved export download) | never | 「—」 ✓ |
  | 复制为新软件包 | `DuplicatePackageForm` (moved) → `duplicatePackage` | `writable === false` | 「—」: deviation, see N2 |
  | 还原到上次发布 | confirmation `AlertDialog`, then `revertPackage` | read-only, or pending count `=== 0` | read-only, or no changes, and asks first ✓ |
  | 收编散落项 | `AdoptLooseItemsDialog` (moved), then `adoptLooseItems` | `writable === false` | read-only ✓ |
  | 在设置中管理… | `setupPackagePath(id)` through the unsaved-work veto; `?package=ID` opens that row's sheet (Disable, Delete) | never | 「—」 ✓ |

  - The menu draws only when `packageId !== null && !pkgMissing && useCanAuthorMetadata()`. `packageId` is `null` on `~org` and `~all` (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx:310`).
  - 「发布全部草稿」 is absent.
  - Unknown writability or an unknown pending count greys nothing; the server gate stays the authority.
  - The `?package=` effect waits for `loading`, which starts `true`, so the param is not dropped before the list arrives.
  - `fetchListedPackageManifests` dedupes in-flight reads only, so Edit never opens on a stale manifest.
- **One copy.** `packagesApiJson` (the old `apiJson`), the export download, the duplicate form and the adopt dialog moved verbatim into `packageActions.tsx`. The detail sheet keeps its testids. `EditPackageDialog`'s prop narrowed to `{ manifest }`, which every old caller still satisfies, and it is still re-exported from `PackagesPage`. The growth beyond a pure move is the two thin request helpers (`revertPackage`, `adoptLooseItems` + `adoptedText`) and the module header.
- **Import moved, nothing stranded.** The admin face's `actions` and `foldedActions` now draw `{importInput}` and New Package on both faces (no `adminFace ? newPackageButton :` branch). The development face keeps its Import unchanged.
  - On `ui/packages/**` source, `importInput` and `engine.packages.import*` appear only in `PackagesPage.tsx`.
  - No e2e or dogfood case asserts that the admin face lacks Import; the `ui/e2e` "Import" hits are the object-view list import.
  - The three admin-face assertions that said "no Import" were flipped in the same PR.
- **Rider #37349: 17 rows, none released, none read.**
  - `released-keys-removed.mjs --tag @object-ui/i18n@18.6.0 --json` gives the same 77-key set at `--ref` base `80da0864` and at head: no row added, none gone, and no `engine.studio.newApp.*` or `menu.typeCount` among them.
  - `git show @object-ui/i18n@18.6.0:…/studio/{en,zh}.ts` has 0 of the 17 in each file; control `engine.studio.changes` is 1 in each.
  - 18.6.0 is the newest tag and the newest npm version.
  - `check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs` on the base `ui/` tree lists exactly the 17 as `[confirmed]`. On the head tree it lists none of them, and no new `packageMenu` key.
  - `git grep` for the 17 outside the catalogues, plus dynamic-prefix spellings, finds 0. The catalogues go from 17 rows per file at base to 0 at head. `nameTaken` and `appFailed` stay, and they are live.
- **Declarations.** `readClause2Line` and `readMetadataProtocolLine` (`scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs` at head) were run on four texts: the newest `Claim:` on #37139 (7175524211), the newest `Claim:` on #37349 (7175566231), the PR body and the changeset. All four read `declared · no · arm null` and `declared · none`, so they match.
  - `Clause-②: no` holds. `app-shell` is private, so its new exports ship nowhere. The studio catalogue is typed `Record<string, string>`, so ten added keys widen no published type. The removed rows were never released.
  - `patch` for both packages matches `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- **Pins at head, and ablations.** In the worktree, `vitest run` over `StudioPackageMenu-37139.test.tsx` and `PackagesPage.installedAppsUpdates-34722.test.tsx` gives `Test Files 2 passed (2) · Tests 76 passed (76)`. I wrote my own 11 ablations, separate from the dev's; each went red alone and was restored, and `git diff --stat HEAD` was empty after the run:

  | Ablation | Red |
  |:--|:--|
  | A1: `{menu}` not drawn in `StudioBackToApp` | 15 of 26 |
  | A2: `readOnly` forced false | 2: read-only greys, en and zh |
  | A3: Duplicate's grey dropped | 2: read-only greys, en and zh |
  | A4: `noChanges` forced false | 2: "nothing changed", en and zh |
  | A5: `canAuthorPackage` dropped | 2: "without manage_metadata"; the control passes |
  | A6: `packageId !== null` dropped | 2: `~org` / `~all` |
  | A7: admin face back to `adminFace ? newPackageButton :` | 5 of 50: the flipped columns case, plus header and Import, each in en and zh |
  | A8: `?package=` effect opens nothing | 1 |
  | A9: Manage in Setup… without `&package=` | 1 |
  | A10: Revert runs without its confirmation | 1 |
  | A11: the zh `packageMenu.duplicate` row removed | 1: zh-CN labels |
- **Check-runs at head (REST).** 58 runs: 45 `success`, 13 `skipped`, 0 failed, 0 pending. Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Test UI (16/16), Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Dogfood Regression Gate, Governed Surface Queue Guard and Check Changeset are all `success`. `l1-face` reads the 13 skips as expected and 0 as unexpected.
- **Merge-tree and K.** `git merge-tree --write-tree` against origin/main `d558de0ae0ef161e5567da4dde1470feca745fe7` exits 0 (clean). K = 8: #37367 landed after the zone's reading of 7. None of the 8 main commits touches any of the 11 files.
- **Overlap.** Pairwise `merge-tree` of each PR's head against this head exits 0 for all three.
  - #37368 (`6fbbdd9b`) and #37380 (`45ed0a4b`) share only `studio/{en,zh}.ts`, in different regions.
  - #37357 (`baa9e0e0`) shares no file.
  - None of the three adds a reader of the 17 removed keys.
- **维护者速读.** Each line is accurate against the diff: the six items and the `manage_metadata` gate, Import beside New Package, the 17 never-released rows, the blast radius (greying only, server-gated, development face unchanged) and the Duplicate deviation. The 「请确认一件事」 line is a veto-window ask, not a gate (N2).
- **Changeset, read sentence by sentence against the diff.** Every sentence holds. These were checked:
  - the zh trigger label 软件包操作;
  - the six labels (Export and Adopt reuse `engine.packages.detail.export` 导出 and `adoptOrphans` 收编散落项);
  - "greyed with the reason on hover" (`title`);
  - "Revert is also greyed while nothing has changed";
  - "`&package=ID`";
  - the ten new keys;
  - the 17 removed rows, with `nameTaken` and `appFailed` kept.

  One wording nit is N4.
- **Contract review.** None is owed. The PR touches none of the four faces: no `Clause-②: yes`, no narrowing arm, no `packages/spec/src/**`, no governed path. So no record is written at either tier.
- **Done-when without Q2 and Q3.** Done-when has four parts: the six items with the table's states and development-face behaviour; Import on Setup → Packages; none on `~org`, on `~all` or without `manage_metadata`; and en/zh pins. All four are met at head without either question.
  - Q2 would add a seventh item and a greyed state the table gives as 「—」. It widens the agreed table, so it is the maintainer's.
  - Q3 is deferred by the card's own Notes ("ask the maintainer once this lands").
  - Both are follow-ups.

### Notes

- N1 — The `l1-face` flag `keywords-other-cards: Fixes #37349` is intended. #37349's claim (7175566231) carries it on this branch, and the fold form is one `Fixes` per member. Its Done-when is delivered in full: the rows are gone from en and zh, the dead-key sweep is clear, and `check:i18n-keys` and Test UI are green. So `Fixes` is right, not `Part of`.
- N2 — Duplicate is greyed on a read-only package (zone ruling Q1 A), where the table says 「—」. This is within Done-when's "each one works the way the development face's action does today": the sheet offers Duplicate only under `authoring && writable`.
  - The server's `requireDuplicableSource` refuses exactly when `!isWritablePackage` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts:1700`). That is the predicate behind the served `writable`, so the grey never hides a door that works.
  - Ablation A3 shows the pin holds the grey.
  - The 速读's 「请确认」 will get no answer before a Tier S landing. Carry it to seat 4's maintainer list beside Q2 and Q3 so the veto window has a reader; flipping it is one line plus its pin.
- N3 — Three files sit outside the claim's literal file surface; all three are explained in the PR body and belong to the card's mechanism:
  - `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (+33): the host that holds the scope, permission, writability and pending facts.
  - `packageSource.ts` (+17): `PACKAGES_PACKAGE_PARAM` and `setupPackagePath`, beside their sibling constants.
  - `packageActions.tsx` (new): the claim's "exposed for reuse, not copied".
- N4 — Cosmetic, optional. In the changeset, "Revert now asks for confirmation first" follows "Each opens the same dialog … as the development view's button", and the development view's Revert still runs at once. "The development view itself is unchanged" and the PR's Acceptance notes close the ambiguity.
- N5 — The report's MCP reads include `get_files` on the merged #37338 and #37166, which git could answer (`git show --stat` on their merge commits). Recorded as the checklist asks; it does not affect the verdict.
- N6 — The dev's out-of-scope note stays as noted, not filed: the development face's Revert has no confirmation. Unifying the two changes the development face, which this card keeps, and Q3 may retire it anyway.
- N7 — Q2 (「新建软件包」 in the menu, and greying 「在设置中管理…」 for a user without the Setup pair) and Q3 (retiring the development face) are maintainer follow-ups for seat 4. Neither blocks this landing.

Landing · 2026-11-26T01:02Z · head `178bfae9` · zone a4-S (#37139 + #37349)

  - Nits N1–N7 are recorded in the L1.
  - The seat carries Q2 (「新建软件包」 in the 「⋯」 menu, and 「在设置中管理…」 for a user without the Setup pair), Q3 (retiring the development face) and N2 (Duplicate greyed on a read-only package) to the maintainer in its final note. Nothing is filed tonight.
- `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 37362`: NOT governed; 1,632 changed lines, under 3,000.
- Checks on the head, newest run of each: 45 success, 13 expected skips, 0 failed (Test UI 16/16).
- K: under 15 (the seat read 8), so no main merge is needed. `merge-tree` with `origin/main` is clean.
- `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. The #37349 rider's 17 removed rows are unreleased (not in `@object-ui/i18n@18.6.0`). Final report 7177958131; finalized-head note on #37139.
- Action: ready, then auto-merge through the merge queue. `Fixes #37139` and `Fixes #37349` close both cards; #37349 carries its own claim naming this branch (7175566231).
